inputs.xtext_rule_text:
fragment FeatureChain returns SysML::Feature :
	ownedRelationship += OwnedFeatureChaining
	( '.' ownedRelationship += OwnedFeatureChaining )+
;

decision: One chaining feature, then ONE OR MORE dotted continuations. The repetition is '+' and not '*', so a feature chain has at least two segments by construction: a single name is not a chain.
notes:
re-scoped from the shared unit to kerml alone (ADR-0015); awaiting grammar_check_unit.py against this language's grammar alone
That is what divides FeatureChainMember's two alternatives. A single name goes through FeatureReferenceMember and only two or more reach OwnedFeatureChainMember, so the two alternatives do not overlap and no lookahead is needed past the first dot.
